mechanism: Betamethasone may increase valacyclovir nephrotoxicity risk through immunosuppression and reduced renal clearance, while valacyclovir has potential for neurotoxicity that may be potentiated by corticosteroid-induced metabolic alterations.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; assess for CNS symptoms (confusion, hallucinations, tremors); consider dose adjustment of valacyclovir if renal impairment develops.
